title: Implement local safety remediation and repeatable patient test bind
objective: Apply the approved evidence-backed identity, recovery, transaction, operational, accessibility, and development-test connection remediations without changing the product architecture or production authorization model.
acceptance_criteria: Development patient connection code is available only in development/test, is paired to one configured patient, and production configuration rejects it
Caregiver authentication and patient device credentials remain separate
Late caregiver session results cannot repopulate another account's cache or settings state
Recoverable patient writes preserve exact pending payloads and never claim unconfirmed completion
Expected transaction uniqueness collisions are handled deterministically and operational database bounds are explicit
Existing frontend and backend quality gates pass without weakening tests or changing navigation
required_tests: Firefox mock browser flow and four-width overflow check
